children: Abakkus Asset Manager Ltd, founded and led by Sunil Banwarilal Singhania, has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with capital markets regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for its Initial Public Offering (IPO).
This is the second fund house to enter the IPO market after SBI Funds Management that launched its public issue in July raising ₹9,813 crore.
The IPO, with a face value of ₹2, is entirely an offer-for-sale for up to 1.50 crore shares by promoter selling shareholder - Abakkus Expert Professionals LLP.
The IPO is primarily aimed at providing the company the benefit of listing its equity shares on the stock exchanges, the fund house said in a release.

The offer is being made through the book-building process, wherein not more than 50 per cent of the net offer has been allocated to qualified institutional buyers, and up to 15 per cent and 35 per cent have been  assigned to non-institutional bidders and retail investors.

Founded in 2018 by Sunil Banwarilal Singhania, a veteran investment professional with over three decades of experience in asset management and equity investing, Abakkus Asset Manager is an asset management platform offering investment management and advisory services across Alternates, Offshore and Other Products, Private Equity and Mutual Funds. Singhania previously served as Global Head of Equities – Investment – Equity at Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd (formerly Reliance Nippon Life Asset Management) from 2003 to 2017.
As of August end, the fund house is managing assets under management of ₹52,609 crore.

The company’s revenue from operations grew from ₹418.60 crore in FY24 to ₹765.91 crorein FY26, a CAGR of about 29 per cent, while the PAT jumped from ₹205.434 crore to ₹327.054 crore, a CAGR of 26 per cent.

According to an ICRA report cited in the DRHP, Abakkus is among the fastest-growing India-focused asset management platforms in terms of non-mutual fund quarterly average assets under management (QAAUM). Its non-mutual fund QAAUM grew at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 18.39 per cent between FY24 and FY26.

Axis Capital Ltd, ICICI Securities Ltd, IIFL Capital Services Ltd and JM Financial Ltd are the book running lead managers, while KFin Technologies Ltd is the Registrar to the offer. The equity shares are proposed to be listed on the BSE and NSE.

title: Sunil Singhania-led Abakkus Asset Manager files draft papers for IPO
